This file documents the cuts resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =cuts=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 4A409D84-090D-5D3B-A870-59356259CA9D
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example

#+end_example

It is addressed at =reporting.v1.cuts.list=.

** =add=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 1648F3ED-AC59-572B-BB89-6D8C21326E23
:END:

Writes a row. The change states that the row must not exist, so a create that collides with an existing row is refused rather than replacing it. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
